# Release Candidate Checklist

- [ ] APIVR tier selected.
- [ ] Authoritative `npm run release-check` passed for the committed release candidate; follow `RELEASE_PROCESS.md`.
- [ ] GitHub Actions passed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated.
- [ ] `VERSIONING.md` followed.
- [ ] Security and supply-chain evidence recorded.
- [ ] Runtime adapters checked.
- [ ] Known limitations recorded.
- [ ] Release candidate report completed.
